summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC incorporating a thirty-ninth supplemental indenture to its base indenture dated August 26, 2009, establishing terms for two new series of senior unsecured notes: $2.25 billion 4.711% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2030 and $2.25 billion 5.208% Fixed/Floating Rate Notes due 2034. The filing is a routine debt issuance disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event is described; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
